claim: *Recovery-ordering model.* The decisive fact is the absent transition from FALLBACK_STAGED directly to DB_UPDATED.

topology.description: Legal recovery sequence; staged artifact cannot skip upload before database update.

required_terms: Durable state may not name an artifact recovery has not yet published.
bw_encoding: Black outlines and arrows; white nodes; sparse 3–7% gray groups. Every non-solid relation is locally labeled; no distinction depends on color.
redesign: Native semantic redraw; colors replaced by labeled relations and line conventions.
alt: FALLBACK_STAGED leads to FALLBACK_UPLOADED on upload success, then to DB_UPDATED when durable state is updated. A crossed dashed direct edge from staged to database updated is forbidden: durable state must not name an artifact before recovery publishes it. The candidate uses black lines, white backgrounds and sparse gray; meaning does not depend on color.
